name: dsh-mobile-nv-failover
description: Mobile-side LLM key-pool failover for NVIDIA NIM (integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1). Reads up to 24 nvapi- keys from a device-local file, round-robins per request, and serves as a chat-completions proxy that swaps keys on 401/403/429/5xx. Settings page lets the user paste keys (one per line) without ever shipping them in the APK.
